_about: Station to Nielsen DMA mapping, as used by Drew's Secret 11.5.

_fields.tier: big4 = ABC/CBS/NBC/FOX slot in the DMA. ranks_with_big4 = non-Big-4 station verified to compete with them. has_newsroom = non-Big-4 station that runs a newsroom and can therefore be judged.
_fields.newscasts: Verified weekday windows as [start_hour, end_hour, label], decimal hours, station local time. [] means no news department. null means not in the census.
_fields.no_news_department: true where the newscast census confirms the station produces no local news.
_fields.feed: Live stream or station site. Some entries are inherited from a shared newsroom - the note says so.
_fields.owner: Licensee or operating group. Sidecar arrangements are named (Mission, Cunningham, Deerfield, Vaughan).

_caveats: Weekday newscast windows are research-verified. Weekend schedules are modelled in the app and are NOT in this file.
Owner coverage is partial - null means not in the register, not unowned.
Affiliations reflect the Nexstar/CBS realignment effective 1 Aug 2026 and the Nexstar-Tegna close of 19 Mar 2026.
US territories are excluded - they sit outside Nielsen's 210 DMAs.
